dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anywhere good to go in Mondstadt?

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: My child, I sense that whatever grave sin you carry with you is weighing heavily on your heart... The best place for you now is surely the confessional?

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: ...Heh. Just kidding, I say that to everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text: But please do not come to me with such trivial questions next time.
